choices: A comment that is visible in the compiled bytecode
A metadata marker applied to code elements that can be read at compile time or runtime
A runtime error message attached to a method
A special import for framework classes
explanation: Annotations (introduced in Java 5) attach metadata to classes, methods, fields, etc. Examples: @Override (compile-time check), @Deprecated (warning), @SuppressWarnings, @Test (JUnit runtime processing). Frameworks use annotations extensively for configuration.
